verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as broadcasting input to or acting on many panes or tabs at once, are a fair axis for a terminal multiplexer, so the story applies. The evidence only shows per-item CLI actions (spawn, send-text to a single --pane-id, get-text, list). Bulk behavior would require the user to script loops over these primitives, which is a developer building block rather than a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
